cases.rationale: A gold spoon has a visible rounded concave bowl and handle over a berry-filled baked dessert on a flat plate. Cake (55) remains unclear: the golden baked portion and dark berry filling could belong to cake or a pie/cobbler-like dessert, and the crop does not resolve the crumb structure. The plate is not a bowl; the yellow sauce is not identifiable fruit. I considered each of the 75 definitions across the whole crop; no other category object is visible.

A slice of yellow cake with a dark filling and decorated top sits on a flat plate. A fork's tines and handle lie behind the slice; the larger background utensil has a cutting blade and wooden knife handle. The glass at upper right has a wine-glass bowl, stem and foot. Plates and cutlery on the cloth establish a dining table. I considered all 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains, and the plates and cake stand do not count as bowls.

The foreground tennis player and people behind the fence are actual humans. The player's red oval stringed racket and grip are identifiable in tennis context. The ball and fence do not meet any of the other definitions, and no seat is sufficiently visible to identify a chair or bench. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual woman works at a kitchen counter beside drinking glasses, a cooker with its oven front/controls visible, and a rear sink/tap assembly partly behind the large pot. The window plants have visible containers. Foreground preserving jars have wide mouths and are not bottles; a rear partially occluded narrow container leaves bottle (39) unclear. Upright utensils near the rear do not resolve a knife blade and handle, leaving knife (43) unclear. Small white rear crockery may be bowls or cup/plate parts, leaving bowl (45) unclear. The large metal cooking pot is not itself sufficient bowl evidence; the work counter is not a dining table. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

The crop shows an actual person's torso, arms and legs holding a bright fabric kite with a black structural frame and lines over sand. The framed fabric is identifiable as a kite rather than an umbrella or a board. Each of the 75 definitions was considered across the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Thin orange carrot ribbons accompany a thick cylindrical sausage between bread pieces on a flat plate. Sandwich (48) and hot dog (52) remain unclear: the bread and filling are visible, but the sausage's frankfurter identity and the sandwich-versus-hot-dog distinction are unresolved. The dark woven support/background does not establish an eating tabletop rather than other furniture, leaving dining table (60) unclear. The plate is not a bowl, and the pickle and onion pieces are not other listed fruits or vegetables. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

Actual people stand and sit on a snowy slope. A vivid pink snowboard with bindings lies beside the seated person at lower left, distinct from the long narrow skis at right. The red-jacketed skier wears an identifiable gray/black backpack with its body and straps on the back. The upper-left ski-lift structure does not identify a bus, train, car or airplane. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual woman holds packaged red toothbrushes; the narrow shaped handles and bristled heads are directly visible through the packaging. Her patterned neckwear is a scarf rather than a necktie. The package is not a bound book, and the brushes are actual objects rather than printed depictions. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual person sits at a wooden eating table with a small drinking cup and a glass bottle with a neck at the left edge. Several recognizable mobile handsets lie in the foreground; separate elongated units with many buttons are remote controls. The Motorola cardboard box and loose papers do not identify a laptop, keyboard or bound book. The metallic cylindrical item near the lower edge lacks a knife blade. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual person's cropped body stands beside a standalone television displaying a bowling game. A clear narrow-neck bottle stands near the lamp, and a handheld buttoned remote is visible among the console equipment. The television stand is not an eating table, and the game imagery does not supply actual depicted objects. Book (73) remains unclear because the small stacked rectangular items on the lower shelf do not resolve bound books versus game/disc cases at this resolution. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

A rusted pair of scissors lies open on rough stone: the two crossing cutting members and loop handles are identifiable. The nearby large cylindrical object is a container with no visible plant, flowers or drinking-vessel context; it does not establish a potted plant, vase, bottle, cup or bowl. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual people and two actual dogs occupy a dining room. Individual wooden dining chairs surround the set dining table. Visible tableware includes narrow-neck bottles, stemmed wine glasses, drinking cups and a deeper serving bowl distinct from the flat plates. Leafy plants in containers sit at the rear window. The tiny silver implements beside plates leave fork (42) and knife (43) unclear because their identifying tines/blades are insufficiently resolved; no spoon bowl is identifiable. Candlesticks and the waste bin are not vases. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.
